title: Movies Explorer
description: Modern Android application that allows you to explore movies and TV shows using the TMDB API.

detailedDescription.title: Overview
detailedDescription.content: Movies Explorer is a modern Android application that allows you to explore movies and TV shows using the TMDB API. The project was developed with a focus on current technologies, following the best practices for Android development.

detailedDescription.title: Architecture
detailedDescription.content: The project uses the MVVM (Model-View-ViewModel) architecture combined with Clean Architecture principles, ensuring a clear separation of concerns, ease of maintenance, and testability. Includes Data, Domain, Presentation and Core layers.

detailedDescription.title: Highlights
detailedDescription.content: Smooth exploration of movies and TV shows, declarative UI with Jetpack Compose, asynchronous programming and reactive data streams using Coroutines and Flow.

title: Moises Android Challenge
description: Modern Android application that allows you to explore, search, and play songs using the iTunes API.

detailedDescription.title: Overview
detailedDescription.content: Moises Android Challenge is a modern Android application that allows you to explore, search, and play songs using the iTunes API. The project was developed with a focus on current technologies, following the best practices for Android development.

detailedDescription.title: Architecture
detailedDescription.content: The project uses the MVVM (Model-View-ViewModel) architecture combined with Clean Architecture principles, ensuring a clear separation of concerns, ease of maintenance, and testability. Includes Data, Domain, Presentation and Core layers.

detailedDescription.title: Highlights
detailedDescription.content: Seamless song playback with ExoPlayer, robust local caching with Room and Paging 3, and a smooth declarative UI using Jetpack Compose.

title: IndraFilms
description: Movie catalog app built in Kotlin, consuming a public REST API with search, favorites and detail screens.

detailedDescription.title: Overview
detailedDescription.content: An app for browsing movies by category, searching the catalog and saving favorites locally for offline access.

detailedDescription.title: Architecture
detailedDescription.content: MVVM with LiveData and Coroutines, Retrofit for the API layer and a repository that transparently falls back to the local cache when the network is unavailable.

detailedDescription.title: Highlights
detailedDescription.content: Smooth list rendering with paging and image caching, plus shared element transitions between the catalog and the movie detail screen.

title: Compose Design System
description: A reusable Jetpack Compose component library with theming, typography and accessible building blocks documented in a live catalog.

detailedDescription.title: Overview
detailedDescription.content: A component library that turns design tokens into a consistent, themeable foundation so product teams stop rebuilding buttons, inputs and dialogs on every screen.

detailedDescription.title: Architecture
detailedDescription.content: Tokens for color, spacing, elevation and typography feed a custom Compose theme. Each component is stateless by default, exposing its state through hoisted parameters so it stays easy to test and preview.

detailedDescription.title: Highlights
detailedDescription.content: A showcase app documents every component and variant, with screenshot tests protecting against visual regressions and full support for light, dark and dynamic color.

title: Notes for iOS
description: Offline-first note-taking app for iOS built with SwiftUI and SwiftData, with tagging, full-text search and iCloud sync.

detailedDescription.title: Overview
detailedDescription.content: A fast, distraction-free notes app where everything works offline and syncs across devices as soon as a connection is available.

detailedDescription.title: Architecture
detailedDescription.content: Declarative SwiftUI views driven by observable view models, with SwiftData handling persistence and CloudKit taking care of synchronization and conflict resolution.

detailedDescription.title: Highlights
detailedDescription.content: Full-text search across notes and tags, Dynamic Type and VoiceOver support throughout, and a widget that surfaces recent notes right on the home screen.

title: brunofelix.dev
description: This portfolio: a multilingual single page application built with Angular to showcase my career, projects and certificates.

detailedDescription.title: Overview
detailedDescription.content: A personal site that brings together my professional background, side projects and certificates, available in English, Spanish and Portuguese.

detailedDescription.title: Architecture
detailedDescription.content: Angular standalone components with lazy-loaded routes under a shared shell layout. State is handled with signals, and content is loaded at runtime from JSON files resolved by the active language.

detailedDescription.title: Highlights
detailedDescription.content: A custom neon theme built on CSS variables and SCSS utilities, scroll-triggered fade-in animations via an IntersectionObserver directive, and a responsive layout tuned from mobile up to wide screens.
